Generic Floor, Quarter Circle Floor, Generic Wall, Doorway Wall, Pillar, Pillar Mounted Torch Sconce, Portcullis, Alcove, Alcove Candles, Hallway Tile, Hallway Stairs, Cultist Altar

A brick trim sheet, a texture atlas, one rusty metal material, one wood material, and a dedicated material for the altar.

results.name: "La Chasse"
results.description:
This Bronze cast created in 1927 by François Rudier is part of the [monumental stairs of Marseille Saint Charles](https://goo.gl/maps/EjkGZ38qHaGS66iB7), in France.

The statue - called "La Chasse" (hunting) - is part of a group of six similar pieces representing the region's products (other being fruits, flowers, fishing, cereal harvesting and grapevine harvesting).

Photogrammetry was done from 164 pictures (Pocophone F1) and processed with Colmap and OpenMVS, but I had to correct some of the upper parts of the sculpture in Blender as I did not have a way to get high angles when shooting.

![](https://www.fortunapost.com/3556/3545.jpg)

results.name: 楼梯部分展示 Stairs - Partial Display
results.description:
楼梯部分展示通常指的是一段楼梯的局部视图，可能只显示几级台阶或一个转角。周围环境可能包括墙壁、扶手、光线投射的阴影等。材质可以是木质、金属或石材，具体取决于楼梯的设计风格。这个场景可能用于建筑设计、室内装饰或艺术摄影中，展现其独特的建筑美感。

Partial display of stairs typically refers to a close-up view of a staircase, showing just a few steps or a corner. The surrounding environment may include walls, railings, and shadows cast by light. Materials can be wood, metal, or stone, depending on the design style. This scene might be used in architectural design, interior decoration, or art photography to showcase its unique architectural beauty.
